g.text: -mementoContainsShape(memento : const DrawingMemento&, id : int) const : bool
+moveShape(id : int, dx : double, dy : double) : void
+restoreShapes(memento : const DrawingMemento&, shapeIds : const ShapeIds&) : void
-transfer(drawing : Drawing&, source : EntryStack&, destination : EntryStack&, shapeIds : const Scope&) : void
+undo(drawing : Drawing&, id : int, mode : RestoreMode) : void
Dashed arrow: dependency (uses a type or its operations).
Drawing owns current shapes; DrawingMemento owns saved copies.
DrawingHistory owns entries in both undoStack_ and redoStack_.
Each HistoryEntry owns one memento and its restoration scope.
Drawing creates and restores mementos; it uses the shape helpers.
Shape depends on its two variant alternatives; helpers use std::visit.
Client calls Drawing and DrawingHistory and selects RestoreMode.
DrawingMemento stores private snapshots; friend class Drawing
grants direct access to the Originator, not the Caretaker.
Group 0 means ungrouped; positive IDs identify linked shapes.
Collect linked IDs before restoring group membership.
Validate every selected ID in both states before modification.
nullopt = full restoration; a vector of IDs = selective restoration.
Save a checkpoint before an edit; saving clears redo history.
Push the current state to the opposite stack, restore the source
snapshot, then consume the source entry. Roll back on failure.
Selective undo consumes the latest checkpoint, not an arbitrary
earlier per-shape state. Later undo / redo preserve the exact IDs.
